title: Just Wanna Make You a Sammich

lines.text: Other girls want roses, diamonds on a ring
Fancy dinners, private jets — the whole big thing
But me, I’m in the kitchen with the bread and ham
Taking my time ’cause I know exactly who I am
They say love should be complicated, hard to understand
But I believe the sweetest things are simple, hand in hand
I don’t need to impress you with some grand design
I just wanna make you a sammich, baby, and make it mine
Turkey or tuna, extra pickles on the side
Cut it in triangles ’cause I know you like that kind
I just wanna make you a sammich
Show you that you’re worth my time
You look at me funny like you don’t deserve the care
Say you’re just some regular guy, nothing special there
But I see the way you light up when someone shows they tried
So let me be that someone, let me be your quiet pride
They chase the spotlight, chasing what they think you need
But I already know the truth — it’s in the little things
I don’t need to impress you with some grand design
I just wanna make you a sammich, baby, and make it mine
Turkey or tuna, extra pickles on the side
Cut it in triangles ’cause I know you like that kind
I just wanna make you a sammich
Show you that you’re worth my time
You don’t have to earn it, you don’t have to prove a thing
Just sit down at my table and let me do this one small thing
[Final Chorus] (softer, then building)
I don’t need to impress you with some grand design
I just wanna make you a sammich, baby, and make it mine
Maybe one day you’ll believe you’re worthy of the kind
Of love that takes its time… yeah
I just wanna make you a sammich
’Cause you’re already perfect in my eyes
